items.quote: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel
items.claim: Moses and Aaron made a public announcement to the Israelites

items.quote: the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt
items.claim: The LORD led the Israelites out of Egypt

items.quote: ye shall see the glory of the LORD
items.claim: The Israelites would witness the glory of the LORD

items.quote: he heareth your murmurings against the LORD
items.claim: The LORD hears the complaints of the Israelites

items.quote: Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full
items.claim: Moses announced that the LORD would provide meat and bread daily

items.quote: the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him
items.claim: The LORD hears the Israelites' complaints against him
